Eject! & Imperial Atrocity”, stamped “(Errata text - March 18, 2010)”<ref name="cdf-20100529-light">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (lightside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref>; with the card list's stamp “Errata text - March 18, 2010” this dates that wording to an errata of 18 March 2010 (He Is Not Ready's “2009” is almost certainly a slip, since Block 4 first came out in December 2009). The order of the two wordings and the title question are still held for a ruling (9 November 2026).
